_comment: Canonical cross-app contract for the Cycle 2 case/workspace/membership domain — see ADR-002 §4/§8. This file is a TEST-TIME-ONLY fixture (both server/test/case-schema-contract.test.js and test/case-schema-contract.test.ts load it and assert their own app's models/constants match it exactly). It is never imported by production code in either app, so it does not reintroduce the shared-runtime-code coupling ADR-001/ADR-002 deliberately avoided — it exists purely to catch schema drift between the two independently-maintained model files at test time.
